MPESB Krashi Vistar Adhikari Online Form 2026 (2784 Posts) - Complete Details

Short Information : Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the post of Group-2 Sub Group -1 Krashi Vistar Adhikari (Agriculture Extension Officer AEO). This recruitment has been issued for 2784 posts. The online application process for MPESB Krashi Vistar Adhikari Recruitment 2026 has started on 03 July 2026, and candidates can apply till 17 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Krashi Vistar Adhikari Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 July 2026
  • Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 July 2026
  • Correction Date : 22 July 2026
  • Exam Date : 02 August 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • SC, ST, OBC, EWS : Rs. 310/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 310/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges : Rs. 60/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
